pieces.Text: You have learned how to use photonic power to bolster your allies in the face of danger. As a reaction while you're attuned or fully attuned, when an ally other than yourself within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can reduce the damage taken by your solarian level (minimum 0 damage). Once you use this revelation, you can't use it again until the next time you regain Stamina Points after a 10-minute rest.
